```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

setwd("/Users/chelseaoliveira/Downloads")

edu_raw <- read_csv("Education70_23.csv", skip = 3)
unemp_raw <- read_csv("Unemployment2023_project1.csv")

colnames(edu_raw)

edu_clean <- edu_raw |> select(`FIPS Code`, pct_no_hs = `Percent of adults who are not high school graduates, 2019-23`, pct_yes_hs = `Percent of adults who are high school graduates (or equivalent), 2019-23`, pct_some_uni = `Some college or associate degree, 2019-23`, pct_full_uni = `Percent of adults with a bachelor's degree or higher, 2019-23`) |> rename(FIPS_Code = `FIPS Code`)
edu_clean <- edu_clean |> filter(nchar(FIPS_Code) ==5, !grepl("000$", FIPS_Code)) |> filter(!is.na(pct_full_uni))

class(edu_clean$FIPS_Code)

unemp_raw <- read_csv("Unemployment2023_project1.csv")

unemp_clean <- unemp_raw |> filter(nchar(FIPS_Code) == 5, !grepl("000$", FIPS_Code)) |> select(FIPS_Code, State, Area_Name, Rural_Urban_Continuum_Code_2023, Unemployment_rate_2023) |> rename(rucc = Rural_Urban_Continuum_Code_2023, unemp_rate = Unemployment_rate_2023) |> filter(!is.na(rucc), !is.na(unemp_rate))

class(unemp_clean$FIPS_Code)

merged_clean <- unemp_clean |> left_join(edu_clean, by = "FIPS_Code")
merged_clean <- merged_clean |> filter(!is.na(pct_full_uni), !is.na(pct_no_hs))

model <- lm(unemp_rate ~ rucc + pct_full_uni, data = merged_clean)
#summary(model)
#plot(model)

"Median_Household_Income_2022" %in% colnames(unemp_raw)

unemp_clean <- unemp_raw |> filter(nchar(FIPS_Code) == 5, !grepl("000$", FIPS_Code)) |> select(FIPS_Code, State, Area_Name, rucc = Rural_Urban_Continuum_Code_2023, unemp_rate = Unemployment_rate_2023, med_income = Median_Household_Income_2022) |> mutate(med_income = as.numeric(gsub(",", " ", med_income))) |> filter(!is.na(rucc), !is.na(unemp_rate), !is.na(med_income))

merged_clean <- unemp_clean |> left_join(edu_clean, by = "FIPS_Code") |> filter(!is.na(pct_full_uni), !is.na(pct_no_hs), !is.na(med_income)) |> distinct(FIPS_Code, .keep_all = TRUE)
colnames(merged_clean)

merged_clean |> select(unemp_rate, rucc, pct_full_uni, pct_no_hs, med_income) |> gather() |> ggplot(aes(value)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "lightblue") + facet_wrap(~key, scales = "free") + theme_dark()
ggplot(merged_clean, aes(x= rucc, y = unemp_rate)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.3) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) + labs(title = "Unemployment and Rurality") + theme_dark()

model1 <- lm(unemp_rate ~ rucc, data = merged_clean)
summary(model1)
plot(model1)

model2 <- lm(unemp_rate ~ rucc + pct_full_uni + med_income, data = merged_clean)
summary(model2)
plot(model2)

merged_clean$log_unemp_rate <- log(merged_clean$unemp_rate)
model3 <- lm(log_unemp_rate ~ rucc + pct_full_uni + med_income, data=merged_clean)
summary(model3)
plot(model3)
```
